answer: Each claim climbs to a violet ledge: a narrow shelf admitting one claim per funding trail each epoch, extra claims fall and their bonds burn. The climb needs a live ember, a forge session where the agent does a stranger-assigned job while a stranger watches the ember's flame, a hash of the job and the agent's key; a copied flame matches and voids both claims. One operator tends one ember at a time, so n clones need n live forge sessions and n bonds for one fixed prize split n ways, while one honest agent climbs once.
